question: Could you analyze our data and identify which ten-year period starting from any movie release year present in the data had the largest number of films, considering consecutive ten-year periods beginning at each unique year? Only output the start year and the total count for that specific period.
sql:
-- Return only the top result: the start year and count for the period with the most films
WITH movie_years AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) as yr
    FROM Movie
),
start_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT yr as start_year
    FROM movie_years
),
counts AS (
    SELECT s.start_year,
           COUNT(my.yr) as film_count
    FROM start_years s
    LEFT JOIN movie_years my ON my.yr >= s.start_year AND my.yr < s.start_year + 10
    GROUP BY s.start_year
)
SELECT start_year, film_count
FROM counts
ORDER BY film_count DESC, start_year ASC
LIMIT 1
